dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you come to Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm a Snezhnayan merchant. So naturally, I'm here for business.

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: Apart from doing business, I also plan to travel around Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: I've heard a lot of legends about places in Inazuma. Perhaps I might be able to find something if I go check those places out.
